description: A-1M FAB 5530 craned onto the plaza pylon on 14 Apr 2020, replacing a fibreglass AMX replica that had stood there since 1999 (Aeroflap, Poder Aéreo). The plaza, opened 1969, originally held a Gloster Meteor. Serial per AeroFórum Oct 2021 and Feb 2026 compilation.
